_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: DXY weakness and spot accumulation signals (exchange drain, options skew) provide a path to Optimism, but Fed liquidity must resolve upward to sustain the grind higher.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — analyst calls UP to Optimism with medium conviction; narrative implies exhaustion/HOLD-leaning without an explicit forward phase call, so the directional lean comes from the analyst's factor pattern read.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.015% with spot CVD turning positive and ETF flows breaking above 80
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY strengthening through 101 and exchange netflow turning sharply positive (>30)
